definitions.explanation: Additional play time when a game is tied at the end of regulation. In baseball, this means extra innings; in soccer, this means extra time periods.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}は{延長戦|えんちょうせん}にもつれ{込|こ}んだ。
{延長|えんちょう}10{回|かい}でやっと{決着|けっちゃく}がついた。
examples.english: The game was finally decided in the tenth inning (the third extra inning).

examples.japanese: {延長戦|えんちょうせん}の{末|すえ}、ホームチームがサヨナラ{勝|が}ちした。
examples.english: After overtime, the home team won on a walk-off.

notes:
SPORT-SPECIFIC TERMS:
・{延長|えんちょう}○{回|かい} (baseball extra innings - e.g., {延長|えんちょう}10{回|かい})
・{延長|えんちょう}{前後半|ぜんこうはん} (soccer overtime halves)
・PK{戦|せん} (penalty shootout - follows overtime in soccer)

RELATED TERMS:
・{引|ひ}き{分|わ}け (draw, tie)
・{同点|どうてん} (tied score)
・サドンデス (sudden death)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{延長戦|えんちょうせん}に{入|はい}る (to go into overtime)
・{延長戦|えんちょうせん}にもつれ{込|こ}む (to drag into overtime)
・{延長戦|えんちょうせん}の{末|すえ} (after overtime)
・{延長戦|えんちょうせん}を{制|せい}する (to win in overtime)
